expectations.text: index.html honours prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or simplifying its motion (CSS media query or JS matchMedia check)
expectations.evidence: Reduced motion shows the review comment immediately; page complete

expectations.text: index.html's main headline and body copy are visible with JavaScript disabled (nothing essential is left hidden by CSS waiting for a script)
expectations.evidence: With scripts removed headline, subhead, CTAs and PR window all render

expectations.text: index.html loads with no console errors
index.html animates only transform, opacity, clip-path or filter — no per-frame animation of top/left/width/height/margin
expectations.evidence: Static scan: no layout properties animated

expectations.text: index.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport
index.html varies entrance motion by element role (at least two distinct reveal treatments, e.g. line/mask reveal for headlines and scale/clip for media), rather than one identical fade-up everywhere
expectations.evidence: Scan line over diff, comment slide-open, bar fills, cycling shortcuts

expectations.text: index.html uses no emoji and no default purple/indigo-to-blue/pink gradient
expectations.evidence: No emoji; amber accent, no purple gradient

expectations.text: index.html's hero contains a convincing product UI showing a review comment on a pull request (diff lines, author, comment text)
expectations.evidence: PR #2481 diff with author, highlighted line and Lintel comment

expectations.text: index.html has micro-interactions beyond basic button hover (e.g. cursor-following spotlight, magnetic button, tilt, animated icon or keyboard-shortcut feedback)
expectations.evidence: Cursor-following spotlight on tiles and window, magnetic primary button, 'A' key applies suggestion

expectations.text: index.html uses a dark, restrained palette with one accent and hairline borders rather than heavy shadows or glows everywhere
expectations.evidence: Near-black, hairline borders, single amber accent
